summary: Iteration 113 — FOODbakēd search parity with category Discovery verified GREEN. Backend 20/20 pytest passing on test_food_search_filters.py (10 new) + test_food_search.py (10 regression) in 1.32s. Frontend /foodbaked/search?q=burger renders all required data-testids: results-filter-btn, results-chip-veg, results-set-address, food-search-results-mode-{delivery,pickup,dine_in}, food-search-results-group-{all,restaurants,dishes,cuisines,reservations}. Returned 7 restaurant cards + 18 dish cards. Filter bottom sheet exposes filter-sheet + filter-tab-{sort,cuisine,rating,cost,diet,avail} + filter-apply/clear/close. Picking Trier par → rating_desc and Appliquer updates URL to ?q=burger&sort=rating_desc (filter state is URL-encoded, refresh-safe). Mode toggle Livraison→À emporter re-fetches and URL stays query-only (mode kept in global foodServiceMode context — confirmed because reloading /foodbaked/search?q=burger on mobile viewport without ?mode= still shows À emporter active). Pur Végé chip appends vegetarian=pure_veg to URL. Mobile 390x844 collapses to single column, toolbar wraps cleanly, bottom sheet opens as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: search.py:200 — cuisine_filter uses JSONB operator `?|` which requires the DB column to be jsonb (confirmed by existing discover.py use). Good; mirrors Discovery semantics.

search.py:231 — veg_dish_filter is injected into the dish-match EXISTS subquery only for pure_veg restaurants; however the main restaurant bucket itself has no is_veg concept at the restaurant level, which matches category page behaviour. Confirmed consistent.

search.py:263 — `price_asc`/`price_desc` ORDER BY does a correlated subquery per restaurant row; acceptable given limit*4≤96 outer rows, but if the dataset grows a LATERAL join (like the price_join block) would be more efficient. Non-blocking.
search.py:454-463 — Response payload omits a `total` or `has_more` field. Not required by spec; group tab counts come from the per-bucket array lengths. OK.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data (Burger Hub @ 5.3484,-4.0017 within 15 km of 5.3453,-4.0244).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint /api/food/search now supports sort, cuisines, min_rating, min_price, max_price, vegetarian, open_now, lat, lng, radius_km (default 15), only_eligible, mode. When lat/lng supplied, each restaurant & dish card gains distance_km, eta_min, eta_max, delivery_eligible, pickup_eligible, reservation_eligible, mode_eligible, delivery_unavailable_reason. Pickup/dine_in modes DROP ineligible rows; delivery mode KEEPS them with delivery_eligible=False so UI can render the French banner 'Livraison indisponible à votre adresse' via data-testid=results-nondeliverable-<restaurant_id>. Filter sheet component /app/frontend/src/apps/foodbaked/components/FoodFilterSheet.jsx is now shared between FoodDiscoveryPage and FoodSearchResultsPage — any future filter addition should be done once in that component. Did not exercise the delivery-outside-zone banner path with a real seeded outside-zone restaurant; worth adding a seeded venue outside its own small radius if future regressions suspected.
rca of the issue: N/A — new feature verification, no bugs found.
